title: Episode 1: The Magic School Breach

scenes.description: At Magic School (under genre Fantasy), The protagonist Valen Frost discovers a flickering holographic map indicating a lost energy archive.
scenes.narration: The episode begins with Valen Frost exploring the mysterious shifts in Magic School.

scenes.description: Deep within Magic School, While decoding the terminal, Valen Frost triggers a lockdown protocol, trapping them inside.
scenes.narration: The situation escalates as Seraphina Sentinel warns of the looming danger.

scenes.description: The final stand at the center of Magic School: They secure the blueprint, but realize the transmission was a decoy sent by rivals.
scenes.narration: A critical choice decides the fate of their mission.

summary: In this episode, Valen Frost and Seraphina Sentinel investigate Magic School to handle breach.
